title: Three Seasons and One Short Net
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：pool　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pool 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the fisherman ① filled the pool that no boatman in the harbour would have measured, and he said the filling was the whole of the season. The ② pool, meaning the basin itself and not the net, ran three seasons and stayed unmeasured in the book; a pool, he said, is the only thing in a harbour that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ pool in that harbour had the same short net beside it, and the ④ pool at the far pier, meaning the catch they kept for the children to land and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A pool, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the fisherman said the measuring is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the pool was the whole of the matter, meaning the share and not the basin. The ⑥ pool, meaning the share and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; pool, he said, is either something you fill or the only word that means both a basin and a share. He said the share is the part they remember.

By 1985 the ⑦ pool had become a line in a logbook, and the logbook had become an argument about the short net. The ⑧ pool of the whole thing, the fisherman wrote in July, was one harbour and three seasons of measuring; pool, he said, is either the catch at the far pier or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ pool I remember is the basin measured in the logbook, which closed in 1987 and is still measured as the quietest in the harbour. A ⑩ pool, my mother said in 1989, is the only basin that improves by being measured; every pool, she said, is a share that has agreed to look like a basin. She said the share was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 水池；水塘（指渔港里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 水池；水塘（指那个水池本身，与小小的渔网相对）
C. 固定搭配：fill the pool 蓄这一个水池
D. n. 水池；水塘（指留给孩子们起的那一网）
E. n. 水池之事（抽象总称，指一处渔港的水池之事）
F. n. 水池；水塘（指航海日志里写到、被测量的那一个）
G. n. 水池、共用（指一件事里人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 共用（抽象总称，指人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: filled the pool that no boatman in the harbour would have measured
The pool, meaning the basin itself and not the net
the pool at the far pier
the pool was the whole of the matter
the pool had become a line in a logbook
The pool of the whole thing
A pool, my mother said in 1989

answers.why: fill the pool 意为“蓄这一个水池”，1980 年那位渔人把渔港里没有一位船工肯测量的一个水池做了一遍。
pool 意为“水池；水塘”，指那个水池本身而不是小小的渔网，它经过了三个汛期而在簿子上没有被测量。
pool 意为“水池；水塘”，指渔港里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一张小小的渔网。
pool 意为“水池；水塘”，指最远那座码头的留给孩子们起的那一网，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
pool 意为“水池、共用”，指一件事里人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个共用就是那件事的全部。
pool 意为“共用”，指人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个水池，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
pool 意为“水池；水塘”，指航海日志里写到、被测量的那一个，到 1985 年这一个成了航海日志里的一行。
pool 意为“水池之事”，渔人七月写道，整件事的水池之事是一处渔港和三个汛期的测量。
pool 意为“水池；水塘”，我记得的是航海日志里测量过的那一个，1987 年归港了，至今仍被说成渔港里最安静的一个。
pool 为抽象总称，母亲 1989 年说，水池是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的水池。
